decisions.finding: 64 lowercase hex regex accepts a nonhex nonce
decisions.reason: The proposed reproduction explicitly uses 64 hex characters. That is a canonical 32-byte hex nonce. Parent origin/source and exact echoed nonce are checked; a new legitimate session selects its nonce by design.

validateSavedCoverage rebuilds canonical groups from exact saved source and compares start/end/text/criterion id. The cited missing helper was omitted from the reviewer packet. Existing coverage tampering tests execute this boundary.

decisions.finding: Blocked candidates survive in API response
decisions.reason: Parser returns candidates: accepted after filtering both blocked capability and unresolved criterion. It does not return the provisional candidates variable. Conditional/conflicting requirement tests already cover this.

decisions.finding: UI decision can retain stale exception set with same report identity
decisions.reason: Server storage forbids mutating a report id, so proposed persisted rewrite is not a valid normal flow. UI now also depends on delivery id, evaluation validity and exception-id signature, and cannot emit a decision for an invalid evaluation.

independentFixes.issue: Bridge ready message declares backend path
independentFixes.resolution: Controller checks ready.backendBasePath equals the server-approved registration path before any command.

limits: No reviewer executed a browser or provider; runtime evidence is collected separately.
